profile.positioning:
I am a seasoned business transformation leader specializing in the strategic implementation of Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI technologies. My core expertise lies in identifying opportunities for AI to drive tangible business value, particularly within complex operational environments. Having spent over a decade in the logistics industry, I've witnessed firsthand the transformative power of AI when applied thoughtfully and strategically. I’m now an independent consultant, partnering with mid-market organizations ($50M - $500M revenue) to navigate the complexities of AI adoption, from initial assessment and proof-of-concept development to full-scale implementation and ongoing optimization. 

My approach is deeply pragmatic. I prioritize solutions that deliver measurable ROI and avoid the pitfalls of 'AI for AI's sake.' I excel at translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable strategies for executive leadership.  Currently, I am particularly focused on the application of Generative AI to revolutionize supply chain management – optimizing forecasting, enhancing resilience, and driving significant cost savings. I’m passionate about building robust, ethical, and future-proof AI solutions that empower businesses to thrive in a rapidly evolving landscape. I believe the future of competitive advantage lies in mastering the intersection of AI and operational excellence.
